notes: brand 'Gentle Monster' is not in the request; using Gentle Monster (the gentleMonster default)

facts: A pair of threshold objects (two rain-washed stone columns) stands 1.0-3.0 m inside the door, with a hanging screen (heavy cable rain curtain) between them; the route slips through a 1.9 m gap.
The hero (central monolith stone hero) stands alone in an empty 8 x 7 m area (central void of stillness); the route circles it and never comes closer than 3.3 m.
Four product stations (four obsidian eyewear displays) sit at the outer corners, outside the loop, so you turn away from the hero to reach them.
The pay desk (dark stone pay desk) closes the loop at the back wall.
anchors: standing just inside the door, between the threshold objects; you look at the two rain-washed stone columns (joint_column)
at the edge of the void, facing the hero; you look at the central monolith stone hero (rock)
turned away from the hero, at a product station; you look at the four obsidian eyewear displays (display)

materials.where: central monolith stone hero, six small obsidian pebbles, fou
walls, ceiling, two rain-washed stone columns

args.title: The Threshold of Rain
args.subtitle: A threshold between the storm and the soul.
args.line: A sanctuary of stone and silence where the relentless noise of the city is absorbed by the weight of the dark monolith.
args.synopsis: You step into the store, passing through a heavy curtain of steel cables that silence the chaotic hum of the Seongsu streets. Before you lies a vast, polished expanse, anchored by a central monolith stone hero that captures the gravity of the room. You navigate around this void, finding eyewear displayed like artifacts on obsidian plinths in the quiet corners. Here, you are alone with your reflection and the stillness of a rainy night.
args.quote: When the rain stops, the stone begins to speak.
why: The threshold columns and cable curtain force a physical slowing down, marking the transition from the frantic city to our internal silence.
The central monolith stone hero acts as a grounding anchor, forcing you to orbit and contemplate the space rather than rush through it.
The four obsidian product stations at the corners ensure your experience is rhythmic, alternating between quiet observation and focused product discovery.
The dark stone pay desk at the back concludes your journey, grounding the final transaction in the same sombre, minimalist language as the entrance.
